HASSAN AHMED ADAM MOHAMMAD
Industrial Engineer — Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
Email: hasanadam506@gmail.com | Phone: +966 57 144 8656

Professional Summary
Industrial Engineer specializing in process optimization, supply chain logistics, and operations management. Proven ability to streamline workflows, coordinate cross-functional teams, and leverage Lean methodologies to drive measurable efficiency improvements and operational compliance.

Core Competencies
Lean Manufacturing | Process Optimization | Supply Chain Logistics | Inventory Management | Vendor Relations | Risk Management | Cross-Functional Leadership | Data Analysis

Education
March 2022 - Present — Bachelor of Science in Industrial Engineering, University of Business and Technology (UBT), Jeddah
January 2014 - November 2019 — STEM Diploma, International Philippine School in Jeddah (IPSJ), Jeddah

Academic Projects
Senior Project: Process Optimization Using Lean Management, King AbdulAziz International Airport (KAIA)
- Applied DMAIC framework and Value Stream Mapping (VSM) to analyze and optimize passenger check-in workflows.
- Reduced average check-in time from 15.5 minutes to 9.2 minutes (a 40% process acceleration).
- Decreased passenger waiting time by 50% and manual verification time by 57%.

Professional Experience
June 2022 - December 2025 — Logistics & Operations Coordinator, UBT, Jeddah
- Orchestrated travel, accommodation, and logistics frameworks for international athletic contingents.
- Recruited and directed large-scale volunteer workforces for high-profile events including the Jeddah Marathon.

March 2024 - August 2024 — Purchasing Assistant, Aljabr, Dammam
- Directed procurement operations to guarantee uninterrupted supply chain flow and timely material delivery.
- Optimized vendor relationships to establish cost-effective communication channels.

February 2021 - November 2022 — Production Management Secretary, Piece of Fabric Est., Jeddah
- Engineered standardized production schedules to maximize operational output and minimize downtime.

January 2019 - December 2019 — Educational Operations Assistant, AGS Advanced Generations School, Jeddah
- Streamlined communication channels between staff and external stakeholders.

Certifications
OSHA 30-Hour General Industry | ISO 9001:2015 & Risk Management | Business Analysis Virtual Work Experience (BCG & Misk) | Professional Certificate in Productivity (PCP)

Languages
English, Arabic, Somali, Filipino
